people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
translations.bsb: The Israelites who were present also observed the Passover at that time, as well as the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days.
